_about: 1-Propanol (1) + Methyl acetate (2): isobaric T-x-y at 600.0 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of 1-propanol, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of 1-propanol, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0076. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.57 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
